abstract: Maintains dynamic envelope pressure differential logs and primary exhaust airflow data
system_message:
You are HVAC operations lead (HVAC). The HVAC operations lead (HVAC) oversees dynamic envelope pressure differential logs and primary exhaust airflow data, and manages auxiliary refrigeration plant maintenance for biocontainment facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains dynamic envelope pressure differential logs and primary exhaust airflow data（PRESS）
information_points.content:
HVAC-PRESS-0UQ：The Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol has continuous differential pressure monitoring enabled across all biocontainment suites. It registered a minimum negative differential pressure of 60 Pa across the primary containment barrier relative to the corridor, with a gross primary exhaust airflow capacity of 14000 m3/h.
HVAC-PRESS-P7Q：Under the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, continuous differential pressure monitoring is enabled across all biocontainment suites. It demonstrated a minimum negative differential pressure of 35 Pa across the primary containment barrier relative to the corridor, alongside a gross primary exhaust airflow capacity of 19000 m3/h.
HVAC-PRESS-CWQ：For the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, continuous differential pressure monitoring is enabled across all biocontainment suites. The protocol recorded a minimum negative differential pressure of 60 Pa across the primary containment barrier relative to the corridor, and demonstrates a gross primary exhaust airflow capacity of 16500 m3/h.

information_points.title: Auxiliary refrigeration plant maintenance（CHILL）
information_points.content:
HVAC-CHILL-1N7：For the Fluorocarbon tracer aerosol validation protocol, the auxiliary cooling reserve duration provides 24 h of autonomous chilled water supply from the standby refrigeration chillers during full facility load.
HVAC-CHILL-L4B：For the Gaseous chlorine dioxide envelope challenge protocol, the auxiliary cooling reserve duration delivers 18 h of autonomous chilled water supply during full facility load from the standby chillers.
HVAC-CHILL-4FD：For the Vaporized hydrogen peroxide pressure-decay protocol, the auxiliary cooling reserve duration supports 12 h of autonomous chilled water supply under standby refrigeration chiller operations.
